scope: Dragonblight from-zero Horde blood-elf paladin foundation only; no insertion/order/hearth/HTML decisions

policy.default_basis: Questie effective objective/start/finish facts manually read once; special or non-obvious tasks are overridden below.
policy.single_character_video_limit: May confirm location/action shape, never fivebox sharing, loot mode, failure behavior, or timing.
policy.fivebox_unknown_rule: Keep sharing/loot mode unknown until current-server fivebox observation; do not invent shared behavior.

manual_unavailable.12015: Test Quest for Craig: test/system residue; exclude from playable route foundation.
manual_unavailable.12021: A Letter Home: obsolete/beta residue with no normal start/finish entities; exclude.
manual_unavailable.12051: Legacy/obsolete partial Harpy row; live quest is 12052《该死的鹰身人！》. Exclude 12051.

facts: Escort the Taunka evacuees across the Borean/Dragonblight boundary to Vortuk; this is the natural map handoff.
Kill/loot Loguhn, then actively use Blood of Loguhn on yourself before returning; killing him alone is insufficient.
verification: whether each character must loot/use separately

facts: This is dialogue interaction with Westwind Taunka refugees: continue the conversation until each oath/progress credit is granted; it is not a normal kill/loot quest.
verification: fivebox dialogue progress sharing vs per-character

facts: Loot a dead Mage Hunter corpse for Personal Effects, then open/right-click the effects until the Moonrest Gardens Plans are obtained.
verification: corpse/item loot mode across five characters

facts: Simple travel/report quest to Agmar's Hammer despite generic 'use' wording in the localized objective; no special player operation identified.
At the southwest Moa'ki dock, use the breathing aid/dive to the wrecked crab trap and interact with it to obtain/start the damaged-trap follow-up.
Direct named kill of Arcanimus; no extra use action is required beyond reaching/killing the target.
Follow the fishing line to the hook, use the bait at the hook to summon Tugowar, then kill him.
verification: whether summon/kill credit is shared for all five

facts: Use the Spiritual Incense at the brazier immediately outside Toalu'u's tent; it triggers a scripted spirit-vision/flight sequence and normally needs no steering.
verification: fivebox object/use action shared vs per-character

facts: Go to the deep-sea pearl, interact with it, follow the sea-goddess script, and when the compulsion/buff prompts you, jump into the water to continue the trial.
verification: whether each character must trigger the scripted sequence

facts: Read Saurfang's letter, then destroy/burn it using the nearby firepot before speaking to the messenger.
Narjun's Pit is below ground; descend through one of the pit openings/holes and explore the lower pit rather than searching only at the surface coordinate.
Collect Yogg-Saron black-blood samples from fixed world deposits; the player-facing action is visually straightforward once in the area.
verification: fixed-object sharing vs personal pickup for fivebox timing only

facts: The target area is inside Narjun's Pit; reach Kilix in the lower pit and kill Anub'ar Underlords there. Surface map coordinates alone are insufficient.
Collect shattered bone pieces among dragon skeletons; no hidden operation beyond world-object pickup.
verification: object pickup sharing only for timing

facts: Fight a Hulking Jormungar to roughly low health until it opens its mouth, then use the explosive during the mouth-open window; loot the charred meat after the explosion.
verification: whether one explosion can credit multiple characters

facts: Use the shredder controller in the harpy area to summon/operate the shredder; collect marked lumber/trees with the vehicle and re-summon if the shredder is lost.
Do this in the same harpy/shredder area as 12050; kill Mistress of the Coldwind and the required harpies. Keep the shredder mechanics in view because both quests naturally share the area.
verification: ordinary kill sharing expected but verify current server

facts: Plant the Warsong battle standard at Icemist Village and defend it until the event completes; do not leave after merely placing the banner.
The Flesh-Bound Tome is a monster-dropped quest-start item from Anub'ar cultist/named mobs in the Icemist/Narjun area; loot it and right-click it to start the quest.
Goramosh drops the Strange Device; loot and right-click the device to start the quest. Do not treat it as an NPC pickup.
Use the teleporter at Moonrest Gardens to reach the projection area, then move forward/observe until the scripted projection credit fires.
verification: whether each character must trigger the teleporter/event

facts: Three named Icemist targets carry separate key fragments; Anok'ra is on the lower/ground level while Sinok/Tivax can be at different points. Collect all fragments before returning.
Kill Captain Emmy Malin for the Ley Line Focus Control Ring, then use the ring at the large ley-line focus arch on the coast to read the focus.
Use the Anub'ar prison key to free the Taunka chieftain, help him fight Anub'ekhan, then loot the required carapace fragment; this is a rescue/event plus boss sequence.
Use the flare at Icemist Village to summon/mount a Kor'kron War Rider; use the vehicle abilities to kill the blightbeasts and return after the vehicle segment.
verification: vehicle must be run per character vs shared kill credit

facts: The sample is taken from a ravaged crystalline giant corpse near/below the Crystal Vice cave entrance; click the corpse, not living giants.
Use Zort's Scraper on yourself when the worm applies/casts Corrosive Spit; repeat until two saliva samples are collected.
verification: each character must be spat on/use scraper separately

facts: Inside the Crystal Vice cave, place/use the crate near a Jormungar Spawn; after the larva enters, pick/right-click the crate on the ground. Repeat for all three.
The feeders are inside the northern Crystal Vice cave; use the cave entrance/path from the Crystal Vice task block rather than chasing surface coordinates.
Rattlebore is inside the Crystal Vice cave; use Zort's protective elixir if available to reduce the acid hazard before the named kill.
verification: whether protective item is per character

facts: Lieutenant Ta'zinni drops the Ley Line Focus Control Amulet; use the amulet at the Lothalor Forest ley-line focus arch to obtain the reading.
Lieutenant Ta'zinni also drops the Horde letter; loot and right-click the letter to start 12085《一封家书》.
Obtain Woodlands Walker Bark in Lothalor and use the bark on the non-hostile/eligible Lothalor Ancients to empower them; this is an item-on-NPC action, not a normal kill.
verification: fivebox item use sharing vs per-character

facts: Speak to Rokhan at the dragon-hunter camp to bring Sarathstra down, then kill her and loot the Frozen Heart.
Use the ley-line talisman at the Indu'le Lake focus, then continue to the Azure Dragonshrine observation point; both spatial checks are required.
Use the vaccine package on living Snowfall Elk and Arctic Grizzlies; it is an item-use vaccination quest, not a kill quest.
Current route already carries the Borean version into Dragonblight; simply turn it in to Elder Ko'nani at Moa'ki Harbor when naturally reached.
Alternate Howling Fjord version of the Moa'ki breadcrumb; current Borean-from-zero route uses 12117 instead.
This Wyrmrest Temple handoff requires reaching the correct temple level; use the temple drake/taxi NPC to reach the upper level rather than searching the ground floor.
verification: exact floor/NPC handoff for Horde branch

facts: Reduce a Deranged Indu'le Villager below the required health threshold, then use the Blood Gem on the weakened target to charge it.
Use the Unholy Gem on Duke Vallenhal as instructed to charge it; do not simply kill the target first.
Use the Frost Gem on the specified frost spirit target to charge it; this is a targeted quest-item action.
Enter the World of Shadows via Koltira's effect/dialogue, kill the Shadowy Tormentors there, then leave the phase/realm when finished rather than searching for them in normal Dragonblight.
Follow the Agmar/Roanauk script and exhaust Roanauk's dialogue/conversation until the allegiance event completes; it is not a normal single named kill despite database simplification.
Follow the snobold trail through the canyon to Icefist rather than searching only the final coordinate; kill Icefist at the end of the trail.
Icefist drops the Ornate Battle Horn; loot and right-click the horn to start this quest, then take it to Wyrmrest Temple for evaluation.

The three magnataur are spread around Wyrmrest and are not identical fights; Ice Shatter has a dangerous channel, and Bloodfeast can heal from nearby maggots. Treat them as three named stops, not one generic kill area.

Reach the runemaster on the cliff/cave side of the Mirror of Dawn; fight him only until the scripted surrender/immunity/quest update occurs. Do not keep trying to kill through the immune phase; avoid the purple runes.
Use the Ornate Battle Horn at the Torch Ring south of Azure Dragonshrine to summon Grom'thar; fight away from the cliff because the encounter has knockback risk.
Inbound breadcrumb from Howling Fjord to Venomspite; current reusable route enters Dragonblight from Borean, so keep it as boundary knowledge rather than an active first-pass task.
Belongs to the Howling-Fjord-side Venomspite entry chain; retain as cross-map boundary knowledge, not current Borean-axis first-pass work.
Emerald Dragon Tears are glowing ground pickups in the area; no hidden operation beyond collecting them.
verification: ground-object sharing only for fivebox timing

facts: Stand by a Scarlet prisoner/soldier and use the blight flask on the target as instructed; the quest is item-use testing, not a normal kill.
Kill Scarlet Onslaught members, then use the Container of Rats on their corpses; corpse use is required for progress.
verification: whether multiple characters can use the same corpse sequentially

facts: Kill an Onslaught Knight to obtain a riding crop, use the crop on the riderless horse, mount it, ride back to Venomspite, and use vehicle ability 1 to deliver the horse. Killing horses directly is wrong.
verification: horse delivery must be repeated per character vs shared

facts: Mount the Forsaken Blight Spreader at Venomspite's east side/gate and use the vehicle blight bombs to kill the required Scourge outside the camp.
verification: vehicle run per character vs shared kill credit

facts: Use the collected siege bombs on New Hearthglen ballistae; the ballistae are fixed targets and must be bombed rather than attacked normally.
The three Daily Orders are in different New Hearthglen buildings/rooms, including barracks/abbey interiors; use building/floor notes instead of treating them as one flat coordinate cluster.
Use the Levine-family termites at the lumbermill/lumber pile to force Foreman Kaleiki out, then kill him.
Burn the ship's sails with the burning liquid, then use the short distraction window to go below deck, navigate the ship interior, kill Captain Shely, and loot the charts.
These named Scarlet targets are not ordinary kill credits: interact/talk as required to expose/trigger them, then kill them. Check each named NPC rather than mass-killing nearby soldiers.
Torturer LeCraft/Alphonse is inside the barracks/basement area; use the branding/interrogation tool five times to get the information before killing/finishing the sequence.
Use the Banshee's Magic Mirror on an Onslaught Raven Priest to steal/copy the disguise image; this is a targeted quest-item action.
At the Obsidian Dragonshrine exit/edge where the road becomes snowy, place the Destructive Ward and defend it until it finishes charging; placement alone does not complete the quest.

Serinar disguises you as a cultist; travel through the Maw of Neltharion cave while disguised to the deep cult area to observe their intent. If the disguise is lost, return/reapply rather than searching outside the cave.
The cultist targets are inside the Maw of Neltharion cave; combine with the same cave pass as 12263/12265/12267 rather than reading flat map coordinates.
Inside the Maw of Neltharion cave, right-click/destroy the necromantic runes; they are fixed cave objects, not surface targets.
Go deep into the Maw of Neltharion, use Neltharion's Flame on the summoning area to trigger/cleanse it and draw out Rothin the Decaying, then kill him.
The Torturer's Rod is a dropped quest-start item from the Scarlet torturer chain; loot and right-click it to start 12271 before returning to Venomspite.
Find each named Scarlet official in the specified building/floor, use the Rod of Compulsion, wait for the denunciation/script, then kill the target.

In disguise, enter the abbey, go up the spiral stairs to ring the bell rope, then return downstairs and speak to/follow the high abbot for the information. Onslaught Knights can see through the disguise.
Abbendis's diary is inside an upper-floor room of the house near the chapel; vertical/building location matters more than the flat coordinate.
This turn-in is tied to the Ruby Dragonshrine fate chain and uses the recovered ruby brooch; keep the item/chain provenance explicit so it is not mistaken for a standalone Wyrmrest pickup.
Wyrmrest Temple has multiple vertical levels; after the Queen/top-level handoff, use the temple drake/taxi or correct level transfer to reach Lord Devrestrasz on the proper level.
Serinar is inside/at the Maw of Neltharion cave in the Obsidian Dragonshrine area; use the cave entrance rather than searching the surface marker.
Enter Ruby Dragonshrine from the south path, collect/use Ruby Acorns on dead red dragons so the corpses return to the earth; this is item-on-corpse interaction.
verification: same corpse usable by multiple characters vs per-character objects

facts: Use the south approach into Ruby Dragonshrine; besides killing necromancers, destroy the corruption/source below the shrine. The second objective is not satisfied by kills alone.
Use the Skytalon Molts at the southeast glade to summon Alystros, then kill and loot the plume; the named target is summoned rather than simply standing at the map point.
Each named target must first be weakened with Seeds of Nature's Wrath and then killed; the targets are in separate locations, including a flying frost wyrm. Do not kill them before applying the seed.
verification: per-character seed use vs shared weakened state

facts: Place/use the Hourglass of Eternity inside Bronze Dragonshrine to start a timed defense/event; protect it through the waves until the information is obtained. A Future You NPC may assist/tank.
The Dragon Queen is on the upper Wyrmrest Temple level; ask/use the temple transport NPC to be sent upward instead of searching the ground floor.
Use the Ruby Beacon to mount a ruby drake, use vehicle abilities to kill the required Scourge, then complete the boss/scythe sequence before returning to the Queen.
verification: vehicle run per character vs shared kills

facts: Wyrmrest Temple is multi-level; confirm the Horde ambassador's correct temple level before leaving the transport NPC, rather than relying on the flat coordinate.
Speak to Tariolstrasz at Wyrmrest and use his drake/temple transport options to move between temple levels; this is the access mechanism for several follow-ups.
Outbound Dalaran breadcrumb/transport task; keep it in boundary data but decide insertion only after comparing the Dragonblight endpoint and actual transport value.
verification: whether the NPC directly teleports current-server characters

facts: Post-Wrathgate continuation: collect Saurfang's battle armor on the battlefield, then carry it back across maps to Saurfang at Warsong Hold. This is not part of the initial Dragonblight opening block.
verification: exact unlock after 12500 and current-server event state
